answer: Sybil tax: each identity pays a non-refundable 20-unit fee. At dawn the registry opens; an applicant burns 20 units for one receipt, and a verifier grants one slot per receipt, so one payment cannot spawn many identities. Making 100 fakes costs 100x20=2,000 units sunk, far above one vote's reward. One honest agent pays 20 once and keeps an undiluted share in the haven of honest workers. This is no fable: the fee is trivial alone, ruinous in bulk.
